title: Prove the ad hoc branch result and its handoff at typed Done seams

intentCoverage.report:
Dough Intent Coverage — one check

Story and revision: .planning/seeds/SEED-413-renovate-dashboard-unit-tests.md#ad-hoc-branch-result-handoff (plan .planning/slice-plans/732-ad-hoc-branch-result-handoff/PLAN.md, slice 4), revision ee549a7b6339e0b8769222146fc4b39091c8dc67 on claude/prove-the-ad-hoc-branch-result-and-its-handoff-a.

Promise (Scope, cursor recovery bullet): "a stale native replacement keeps a branch identified while it was pending." Expected observable behavior: after Cursor's replacement chat is swapped in (replaceKeptSession) and a stale native writer then binds the replacement (bindRecord with a record built before the branch was identified, so carrying no branchEntry), the kept replacement still carries the entry identified while pending: identifyBranch answers that entry (committedTip = the pre-entry tip) and review answers the branch result.

Verdict: Caught.

Fault (validated and narrowed from the suggestion): dashboard/server/launchRecordBinding.ts, bindRecord, in the existing-record merge — added `branchEntry: undefined` immediately after `...keptBranchEvidence(existing),`, so a bind over an existing kept record drops the branch entry it already held. This is the exact "stale native replacement" path: the scratch witness showed the in-memory replacement passed to bindRecord carries branchEntry null, so only keptBranchEvidence(existing) in bindRecord preserves the entry. replaceKeptSession was left intact (one fault only). No fixtures or assertions were changed.

Maintained check examined: dashboard/backend-tests/review/ad-hoc-branch-cursor-recovery.spec.ts, case "a stale native replacement retains a branch identified while it was pending".

What caught it: the case's first expectation, `expect(await identifyBranch(checkout, kept, { workspace, branch })).toMatchObject({ committedTip: present })` (spec line 188-190). The catch happened inside identifyBranch (backend-tests/support/declaredBranchCase.ts) -> recordSessionBranchEntry (dashboard/server/sessionBranchEntry.ts:74, entryRepository): with no kept entry on a Done record it refused with RefusedRequest 409 "Identify the branch while the session is still open." The toMatchObject matcher itself was not reached; the case failed in 778 ms, an assertion-path failure, not a timeout (5 s limit). The claim is limited to this observed path (stale bindRecord after replaceKeptSession on a Done Cursor declared-branch launch).

Run observations:
- Setup: scratch worktree `git worktree add --detach` at ee549a7b6 under /Users/terryyin/.claude/jobs/957e81fd/tmp/ic-scratch, Node 24.21.0 matching .node-version, `npm ci`; pre-probe `git status --short` empty.
- Baseline: `caffeinate -s -i env -u NO_COLOR -u FORCE_COLOR -u GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES npm run --silent test:dashboard:backend -- dashboard/backend-tests/review/ad-hoc-branch-cursor-recovery.spec.ts` — 3/3 passed; target case 1197 ms (Vitest duration 6.06 s). Load average about 6.
- Reach and independent witness: a temporary scratch spec (copy of the target case's setup through bindRecord/keptSession, logging instead of asserting) ran with and without the fault. Unfaulted: kept branchEntry present with committedTip = `present` commit, identifyBranch answered the same entry. Faulted: kept branchEntry null, and identifyBranch threw the same 409. This independently observes the promised behavior going wrong (the replacement lost the branch identified while pending) on the intended path.
- Faulted focused run: same command — 1 failed, 2 passed; the two Cursor pin-release cases (deletion, expiry) still passed, as expected since they do not route through the bindRecord existing-record merge.
- Restoration: fault applied under a shell `trap 'git checkout -- dashboard/server/launchRecordBinding.ts' EXIT`; scratch witness spec deleted; `git status --short` and `git diff --stat` empty, matching pre-probe state; same focused command rerun — 3/3 passed (target case 854 ms, duration 3.75 s). Scratch worktree then removed with `git worktree remove --force` (forced only for ignored node_modules/test-results); it no longer appears in `git worktree list`. The execution checkout was not edited: still at ee549a7b6, `git status --short` empty.

Next proof action: none required for this promise; the maintained case catches a dropped branch entry on the stale-native-bind path. Optional: the catch rides on recordSessionBranchEntry's Done refusal rather than on the committedTip matcher, so if a stronger direct witness is wanted, an assertion that the kept replacement's branchEntry equals the entry identified while pending would name the expectation explicitly. That is a suggestion for the caller, not a repair decision caused by the probe.

Prior disposition: the caller noted no planned fault had been run against this relocated promise; this probe supplies that missing fault evidence. No already-planned repair is matched.

Costs:
- Test runtime: measured, Vitest-reported duration of the focused file: baseline 6.06 s, faulted 3.69 s, restored 3.75 s (about 13.5 s total); plus two witness runs (target case 780 ms and 757 ms, file durations not captured). npm ci wall time not separately measured.
- Human effort: unavailable — no human participated in this automated check.
- Agent effort: unavailable as a separately supported measure — no token or tool-call meter is exposed to the agent; the elapsed entry below bounds wall time.

- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 102080 ms (measured), from 1795171231000 to 1795171333080 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.

Wrap-up disposition: checked revision ee549a7b6339e0b8769222146fc4b39091c8dc67, verdict Caught, no follow-up.
